items.description: Puerto Morazan is a river port town in the Chinandega department, located on the Estero Real estuary.
Tecolostote is a small town in the Boaco department, known for its scenic views of the surrounding hills.
San Miguelito is a town in the Rio San Juan department, situated along the shores of Lake Nicaragua.
San Juan del Norte, historically known as Greytown, is a remote town on the Caribbean coast.
Pueblo Nuevo is a municipality in the Esteli department, located in the northern mountainous regions.
Esquipulas is a rural town in the Matagalpa department, surrounded by coffee plantations.
La Dalia is an agricultural hub in the Matagalpa department, essential for coffee and vegetable production.
Matiguas is a municipality in the Matagalpa department, primarily driven by livestock and dairy farming.
San Ramon is a historic town in the Matagalpa department, known for its mining past and current agricultural role.
Terrabona is a rural town in the Matagalpa department, situated in a scenic valley.
